title: LumiPic SDR-to-HDR Image Diffusion
summary: LumiPic is an open-source tool that converts Standard Dynamic Range (SDR) images into 16-bit High Dynamic Range (HDR) EXR files using diffusion transformers. It utilizes LogC3-encoded diffusion to reconstruct missing highlight and shadow details for professional VFX pipelines.
research_notes: Generates scene-linear EXR files compatible with Nuke and DaVinci Resolve; integrated into ComfyUI via the ComfyUI_Gear node suite.

evolution.summary: Adapted from LumiVid research for single-image reconstruction, the project has expanded to support large-scale DiT models. It currently offers production-ready LoRAs for Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 and experimental support for the faster FLUX.2-klein architecture.
